battle_traits.name: Ancient Burial Sites
battle_traits.effect: If there is a friendly Cursed Sepulchre on the battlefield, you can set up to 2 additional friendly Cursed Sepulchres on the battlefield. The first must be set up more than 3" from all units, objectives, and other terrain features. The second must be set up wholly outside enemy territory and more than 3" from all units, objectives and other terrain features.

options.name: Designer’s Note
options.text: The original Cursed Sepulchre is set up in Step 1 of the deployment phase using the 'Deploy Faction Terrain' ability. This ability allows you to set up a second and third such terrain feature and is used in Step 3 of the deployment phase, after armies have been deployed.

battle_traits.name: The Unquiet Dead
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly DEATHRATTLE or DEADWALKERS unit that has not been deployed.
battle_traits.effect: Set up that unit in reserve in the grave. It has now been deployed. You cannot set up more friendly units in the grave than there are on the battlefield.

battle_traits.name: The Rising Dead
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in the grave.
battle_traits.effect: Set up that unit wholly within 6" of a friendly Cursed Sepulchre and more than 9" from all enemy units, or wholly within 6" of the edge of the battlefield, wholly within friendly territory and more than 9" from all enemy units.

battle_traits.name: Deathly Invocation
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS HERO to use this ability, then pick up to 3 friendly DEATHRATTLE or DEADWALKERS units wholly within 12" of that Hero to be the targets.
battle_traits.effect:
For each target:
• If the target is damaged, Heal (3) the target.
• If the target is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.

battle_traits.name: Endless Legions
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly non-UNIQUE DEATHRATTLE or DEADWALKERS unit that started the battle with 2 or more models and that has been destroyed to be the target.
battle_traits.effect:
Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS HERO or wholly within 6" of a friendly Cursed Sepulchre. It must be set up more than 9" from all enemy units.
If it is your movement phase, you can set up the replacement unit more than 3" from all enemy units instead of more than 9", but if you set it up within 9" of any enemy units, it cannot use CHARGE abilities this turn.

battle_traits.name: The Hunger
battle_traits.declare: Pick each friendly VAMPIRE unit that used a FIGHT ability this turn to be the targets.
battle_traits.effect: Heal (D3) each target. Heal (2D3) the target instead if it destroyed an enemy unit this turn using a FIGHT ability

abilities.name: Horror Unending
abilities.effect: You can pick 1 additional target when using the 'Deathly Invocation' ability.

abilities.name: Dragged Down and Torn Apart
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly DEADWALKERS units in combat to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
For each target:
• Make a pile-in move.
• Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Aristocracy of the Night
abilities.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly VAMPIRE units that are not in combat and add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly VAMPIRE units that charged in the same turn.

abilities.name: Tide of Bones and Blades
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly DEATHRATTLE units that charged in the same turn for attacks that target a unit that has fewer models than the attacking unit.

abilities.name: Wardens of the Wolf
abilities.effect: Each time 1 or more slain models are returned to a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS INFANTRY or BEAST unit wholly within 12" of a friendly Belladamma Volga, Radukar the Wolf, Radukar the Beast, Ivya Volga, Lady Annika, Kritza, Torgillius the Chamberlain, Gorslav the Gravekeeper or Watch Captain Halgrim, add 1 to the number of slain models returned to that unit.

abilities.name: Unholy Site
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Cursed Sepulchre to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target has WARD (4+) until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: The Speed of Death
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly INFANTRY VAMPIRE HERO to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target can move up to 12" and has FLY when it does so. It cannot end that move in combat.

entries.name: Lash of the Sire
entries.declare: Pick another friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS unit within this unit's combat range to be the target.
entries.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 2+:
• If the target is not in combat, it can move D6" but cannot move into combat during any part of the move.
• If the target is in combat, it can make a pile-in move.

entries.name: Unbending Will
entries.declare: Pick a friendly DEATHRATTLE or DEADWALKERS unit that has 2 or more models and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
entries.effect: Add D6 to the target's control score for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Unhinged Rampager
entries.effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for this unit in your charge phase.

entries.name: Immortal Ego
entries.effect: Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll and 1 save roll for this unit.

entries.name: Furious Endings
entries.effect: Each time a MANIFESTATION within 12" of this unit is removed from play, gain 1 rage dice.

entries.name: Eternal Thrall
entries.declare: Pick another friendly non-UNIQUE SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS INFANTRY HERO to be the target.
entries.effect:
For the rest of the battle, while the target is on the battlefield:
• If this unit is a NECROMANCER, add 1 to this unit's power level.
• If this unit is a VAMPIRE, add 1 to unbinding rolls for this unit.
• If this unit is DEATHRATTLE, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.

entries.name: Immortal Ego
entries.effect: Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll and 1 save roll for this unit.

entries.name: Frightening Vitality
entries.effect: Each time an ability would heal exactly 1 or 2 of this unit's damage points, heal 3 damage points instead.

entries.name: A Wastrel and a Vagabond
entries.effect:
While a friendly Deadwalker Zombies or Deathrattle Skeletons unit is wholly within 12" of this unit:
• Add 2 to run rolls for that unit.
• Add 3" to the distance that unit can move when it piles in.

entries.name: Terminus Clock
entries.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from casting rolls for enemy WIZARDS while they are within 18" of this unit.

entries.name: Shard of Night
entries.effect: Ignore modifiers to save rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit (positive and negative).

entries.name: Amulet of Graves
entries.effect: If there are fewer than 3 friendly Cursed Sepulchres on the battlefield, set up a Cursed Sepulchre on the battlefield more than 9" away from all enemy units, more than 1" from all friendly units and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features.

entries.name: The Empty Graveyard
entries.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again more than 9" from all enemy units and either wholly within 7" of a terrain feature or wholly within 7" of the battlefield edge. This unit cannot use MOVE abilities in the first turn of the first battle round.

entries.name: The Never-Dead
entries.effect:
Spend 1 rage dice. If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Then, for the rest of the turn, each time you make an unmodified save roll of 5+ for an attack that targets this unit, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

entries.name: The Incarnadine Killers
entries.effect: If this unit is not in combat and an enemy unit was destroyed by its combat attacks this turn, this unit can move up to D6". It can end that move in combat.

entries.name: Vile Transference
entries.declare: Pick a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit. If any enemy models were slain by this spell, Heal(D3) the caster.

entries.name: Prison of Grief
entries.declare: Pick a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: The target has STRIKE-LAST until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Waste Away
entries.declare: Pick a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of the target's melee weapons.

entries.name: Summon Hand of Nagash
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Hand of Nagash on the battlefield, pick a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Hand of Nagash wholly within 12" of and visible to the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Summon Sanguine Swarm
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Sanguine Swarm on the battlefield, pick a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Sanguine Swarm endless spell wholly within 12" of and visible to the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units. A Sanguine Swarm endless spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

entries.name: Summon Unholy Reliquary
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Unholy Reliquary on the battlefield, pick a friendly SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Unholy Reliquary endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster, visible to them, and more than 3" from all enemy units.
